messages:
olivia: SUP-4821 customer reporting rerank endpoint timeouts under load during A/B campaign. p95 jumped from ~400ms to 3-6s, lots of 504/gateway timeouts. attaching minimal repro.

prod-monitor: alert: rerank-service.p95 > 3s for 5m; 504 count=42; region=us-west-2 :warning: 

devon: can you paste the exact request payload + headers? need batch_size, max_candidates, model id, and client timeout settings

olivia: here's sanitized request —
```json
{
  "model": "rerank-v2",
  "client_id": "acme-campaign-9",
  "queries": ["how to clean running shoes","best trail sneakers"],
  "candidates": [["c1","c2","c3"], ["c4","c5"]],
  "max_candidates": 100,
  "timeout_ms": 15000,
  "batch_size": 64
}
```

sasha: That batch_size + max_candidates looks high. 64 * 100 = a lot of token work per request. KV cache churn + large batching can push kernel selection to slower paths. Also are they using streaming? any client retries? :thinking:

ryan: we saw a gateway retry storm last week. default client retries=3 with no jitter here will amplify partial failures. check X-Request-Retry and X-Gateway-Retry headers in logs.

olivia: logs show many downstream 502/5xx from model-backend and 'upstream prematurely closed connection' / 'read timeout' traces. lots of repeated retries from same client id. sample lines: `ERROR rerank_backend: read timeout after 30s`, `WARN gateway: retry count=3 for req_id=abc123`

matt: Dashboard snapshot: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/rerank?from=now-1h&to=now — p95 spike aligns with campaign start at 2026-03-17T14:32:10Z. pod restarts low, but CPU & memory on rerank-pool nodes spiked.

devon: immediate mitigation suggestions: reduce batch_size to 16, lower max_candidates to 25, unset client retries (or add exponential backoff + jitter), increase client timeout_ms to 30000 so gateway has time to surface errors gracefully. Consider routing to rerank-light model variant.

ryan: I'll push a temporary gateway rule: disable retries for 5xx on /v1/rerank, add small jitter to existing retry policy, and scale up rerank-pool in us-west-2 by +2 pods. that should stop the retry-amplification.

sasha: also adjust circuit breaker for rerank path — lower failure threshold to fail-fast (3s) so we don't tie up upstream capacity serving long tails. add per-customer concurrency cap for campaign clients.

olivia: applying changes now and re-running repro with smaller batches. will update the customer (SUP-4821) with mitigations. thanks. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket SUP-4821 updated: mitigation steps applied, customer notified.

prod-monitor: update: rerank.p95 back to ~420ms after changes; 504 count dropped to 0 in last 10m. :white_check_mark:

olivia: closing loop here. follow-ups: document recommended max batch/candidates, add per-customer throttling policy, add synthetic load test that mimics campaign patterns. created follow-up ticket ENG-1097.

matt: good postmortem candidate — the interaction between client retries + large batch sizes + backend 5xx is an easy regression to miss.

olivia: agreed, will spin up a short blameless postmortem doc and link dashboards + logs.

end of thread.
